Ben_Tre_DBSCL.name: Bến Tre (Mekong Delta)

ndvi_point.note: Rice field near Mỹ Nhơn market (former Ba Tri district, Bến Tre; now part of Vĩnh Long province). Picked on satellite imagery.

Ben_Tre_DBSCL.season_start_source: Winter–Spring rice in coastal areas: 'finish all sowing within October to November (solar calendar)' (National Agricultural Extension Center (NAEC), drought and salinity intrusion handbook for the 2026–2027 dry season, p.10, translated from Vietnamese). Ba Tri: Winter–Spring rice sown around 22/11/2023 and harvested at the end of 2/2024 (Báo Nông nghiệp Việt Nam [Vietnam Agriculture newspaper], 22/02/2024).
